request.input:
2::original faction insignia, monochrome graphic emblem, no humans::, a compact angular interlocking silhouette made from one modern tactical rifle and one straight double-edged sword. Rifle points toward upper left, sword points toward upper right. Clear rifle barrel and magazine, clear sword tip and short crossguard. The two weapons join into one deliberate heraldic mark; broad cutout negative space at the center suggests the hooked structure of Chinese numeral nine without written typography. A small separated angular foot anchors the base.

Original identity emblem for Section Nine, a tactical organization in a dystopian game. Professional faction logo, recognizable silhouette, screenprinted military insignia, flat graphic design takes precedence over illustration.

One emblem centered on a plain charcoal background. Strong balanced compact silhouette, generous empty margin, readable thick shapes and deliberate negative-space gaps. Weapons are integrated into a designed abstract symbol, not realistic objects laid across one another. No lettering, no border, no shield, no wreath.

Solid warm white silhouette, charcoal cutouts, absolutely flat two-tone graphic, crisp edges, no material rendering, no glow, no scenery.

0.9::quasarcake::, 0.5::rella::, 0.4::gomzi::, 0.3::piromizu::

arknights, game promotional illustration, painterly anime illustration. Complete, clean silhouettes and carefully resolved facial features and hands. Use clear grouped shadows and angular cloth folds. Keep fine linework selective around the eyes, fingers and accessories. Skin has delicate restrained transitions. Alternate crisp focal edges with softer background edges while keeping contours complete. Rich but controlled color, precise focal detail, quieter background detail.

masterpiece, best quality, very aesthetic, masterpiece, no text, rating:general
